carmen_citrus.descricao: Carmen Citrus is a tribute to our special chef Carminha. This light, fruity, and aromatic drink was created in honor of International Women's Day. It features notes of vanilla, strawberry, and Sicilian lemon.

juju_tropical.descricao: For those who want to celebrate with a citrusy and fruity drink, Juju Tropical was added to the menu as a tribute to our dear Judith. A mix of pitaya, passion fruit, and mint.

lili_twist.descricao: And for those who love a drink with the freshness of ginger, we created the Lili Twist — a blend of pineapple, lemon, propolis, and ginger foam. A special tribute to our beloved Liliane!

fitzgeria.descricao: Gin, Sicilian lemon, Angostura Bitter, sparkling water, and sugar syrup.

rabo_de_saia.descricao: Cynar, cachaça, Jägermeister, Angostura, orange, cane molasses, and Sicilian lemon.

caipi_gere.descricao: Brown sugar syrup and Tahiti lime.

gere_tropical.descricao: Our tropical Geremia — a refreshing drink made with a shot of Beefeater gin, passion fruit, and Red Bull Tropical energy drink.

caraiva.descricao: Drink with strawberry, passion fruit, and tangerine.

maracujack.descricao: A future favorite at Gerê — a mix of Jack Daniel's whiskey and passion fruit pulp.

mojito.descricao: A cocktail made with rum, sparkling water, lime, and mint.

aperol_rose.descricao: Aperol, brut sparkling wine, orange juice, Sicilian lemon, and strawberry syrup.

negroni.descricao: The classic Negroni — a timeless favorite that needs no introduction.

moscow_mule.descricao: Vodka with ginger and lemon syrup and foam.

ura_sem_alcool.descricao: A non-alcoholic drink made with pineapple, strawberry syrup, and sparkling water.

soda_italiana_sem_alcool.descricao: A non-alcoholic drink made with fruit syrup, lime juice, and sparkling water. Flavors available: Strawberry, Tangerine, or Green Apple.

suco_verde.descricao: A blend of lime, basil, kale, pineapple, ginger, and coconut water.

suco_de_pitaya_com_abacaxi.descricao: A blend of pitaya, pineapple, mint, ginger, lime, and coconut water.
